image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming in an underwater environment. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes on a laterally compressed body. Its dorsal fin spines are elongated and fan out prominently above the back. The pectoral fins are large, translucent, and fan-like with visible rays. The head is large with a visible eye and mouth structure.
